$comment: Annotation presets for the english-structure-highlight skill. Each preset is a complete Notion rich_text `annotations` object — always send every flag explicitly. Colors are standard Notion font colors. Default legend has 7 layers: subject / verb / object / relative clause / comparative / object complement / collocation overlay.

collocation_default_italic.$comment: OPT-IN ONLY. Not part of the default legend: default-territory text must stay pure default (see SKILL.md Core Rule 'Default means untouched'). Use this preset only when the user explicitly asks to mark standalone collocations outside colored segments.

alternatives.$comment: Use when the user prefers background highlights over font colors, or when yellow font is hard to read on white.

collocation_overlay.$comment: Collocation is an OVERLAY layer, not a standalone color. Rule: take the segment's existing role annotations and set italic=true, keeping the role's color. The overlay lands ONLY on already-colored object/complement segments (blue family) — e.g. collocated object 'reduce stress' stays blue+italic (already italic, unchanged). Chunks lying in default territory are left completely untouched: default text = pure default state, every flag false (see SKILL.md Core Rule 'Default means untouched'). Never add italic to verbs/subjects/relative clauses solely because they belong to a chunk — grammar roles always win.
collocation_overlay.apply: merge { italic: true } into existing annotations of blue-family segments only

example_segments.$comment: Sentence: 'Loyal employees are a company’s most precious asset. However, in today’s competitive job market, salary alone is no longer enough to keep people at their desks.' Concatenating all `text.content` values must equal the original string exactly. This array is the `self-written` cell (index 3) of a table_row payload: { type: 'table_row', table_row: { cells: [ ...otherCellsUntouched, EXAMPLE_SEGMENTS, ...otherCellsUntouched ] } }

text.content: . However, in today’s competitive job market,
to keep people at their desks.

update_block_payload_skeleton.$comment: Skeleton for notion_update_block on a table row. cells must contain ALL columns of the row; untouched cells are copied byte-for-byte from notion_retrieve_block output. NEVER double-nest a cell ([[{}]] fails with 400 validation_error).
